metaDescription: Order custom 1 badges in bulk for your team or event. Fast turnaround and free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 1 badges offer a compact and professional way to display names, roles, or credentials. Ideal for conferences, retail staff, or corporate security, these 1-inch badges fit standard ID holders and badge reels. Choose from metal or plastic materials, and add your logo with full-color imprint or engraved text. Ordering in bulk keeps per-unit costs low while maintaining a polished, uniform look for your team.
heroAltText: Custom 1 badges with engraved text and logo, perfect for name tags and ID badges in bulk orders
